rules.statement: After V woke in 2079, V called Judy; she said she now lives in Pittsburgh and is married, and that she could not help V now.
Before the stadium op, V told Reed that Songbird had admitted she was not telling the whole truth and planned to slip out of Night City right after Hansen went down; Reed thanked V for the candor.
The night before the stadium op, V joined Alex at the bar where she was having a drink to calm her nerves, and danced with her. This was a moment of trust, not a confirmed romance.
In the stadium lab, on Songbird's side of the split, V gave Alex the signal and she shot Kurt Hansen ("Target down"); Hansen was dead as V escaped with Songbird.
On Songbird's branch at the stadium, Alex shot Hansen at V's signal and survived the operation; she later reached out to V by holocall.
At Cynosure the dying Songbird begged V to end her life ("End it"), calling death her only way out; V refused, and she said V was leaving her to a fate worse than death.

V refused Angie's deal at Damir's clinic and fought her crew; Angie and her two Animals went down while Aaron was under, and he woke to the aftermath. The record does not distinguish killing from knocking them out.
Aaron's bout went ahead under Angie's control: he went down in the third round as the Animals had arranged, and Angie kept the option of using his chip.
Steven met V in Night City after Spy in the Jungle, thanked V for what happened in Dogtown, and said he was working and looking at a promotion. Whether V asked about Ana or SovOil is not recorded.
At their Night City meeting Steven handed V the payment he had promised, "so you know I keep my word."
During Spy in the Jungle Steven texted V privately to leave the biomonitor at the drop point and not give it to Ana, saying leaked news of Bana's death would only hurt them.
In the Voodoo Boys' base Alan Noël identified himself to V as an undercover NetWatch agent, an organized-crime specialist, and V let his operation continue.
Alan later messaged V: Milko had led NetWatch to a Belgrade arms dealer selling the old Militech bots, who was now in a cell. Alan sent V a reward for the help.
V visited Bill at his new scopdog stand in The Glen. He had quit the NCPD, said V changed his life, and offered V eddies as thanks.
Briana found out that V had let Rinder live. She confronted V in the Stacks, said V had no right, and told V never to show their face there again.
When Paco's generator mess put him and Babs in danger, V proposed framing Yuri, who was already on Hansen's bad side.
V told Paco and Babs to run for it; Babs chose to stay in Dogtown, and Paco agreed to let V smuggle him out alone.
V called in favors so nomads could get Paco and Babs out of Dogtown; Paco messaged that V's friends got them out.
With nomad help, Paco and Babs left Dogtown through the Badlands, and Paco later messaged V that they had made it to Nairobi.
Instead of fleeing, V found replacement gear for Paco's lost generators through a contact (River). Paco messaged that V's choom had sorted them out.
The replacement gear V got through River solved Paco and Babs' generator problem. Paco messaged that all was good and left V a thank-you gift in their Dogtown tent.
After the plan to frame Yuri, Paco was killed. V found his body under the Needle and messaged Babs: "They got him, Babs. I'm sorry."
V smuggled Paco out of Dogtown alone. Later, at the Afterlife, he told V he had got in with the scavs, starting the next day, and gave V a souvenir as thanks.
